entries.title: Satisfactory

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the original full-release route and keeps the best fidelity, mouse/keyboard control, capture flexibility, and PC ecosystem support. The later PS5 and Xbox Series X/S versions are valid console routes but do not add sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Satisfactory on Steam, Epic Games Store, or the Humble Store for Windows PC and keep it updated to the latest 1.x build.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC full release after Early Access.
all_releases.reason: primary: original full-release route with the best capture, input, and PC support.
skip: console route with controller-focused support, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox Series X/S console release.
all_releases.reason: skip: console route with Xbox/PlayStation cross-play support, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The console versions do not have exclusive game content; PC remains both complete and the highest-fidelity archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The console versions are later ports/access routes, not separate remasters or definitive editions. Console cross-play is between PlayStation and Xbox platforms, not a unique content mode.
